notes.title: Big Update Ver 1.0.3 -----Boss Levels!
notes.notes:
As the notice in our last announcement, we added a separate boss fight level for every stage ːsteamhappyː , however to unlock them, you still may have to get though each stage for a first time.

In the boss fight levels, you could practice more in order to know your enemies better, and the use of your favorite combinations of special modules would also be a game changer:).

Besides:

  [*] Main menu optimizations;
  [*] Reduce glitches from some objects, will keep optimizing this part.


Cheers,
Ke

notes.title: First Update after Launch!
New Demo Version is Alive.
New Demo Version Updated! Some Major Changes of Gameplay!
notes.notes:
NEUN Games team is busying building new maps and features of Revoke's EA version～
In the mean time we'd still be adding latest process to the demo.

As a balance for the difficulty increasing, 
we made skills stronger and easier to use. Here comes the update:

1. Both hands holding guns! So it'll no longer trouble left-handed players now:), you can more focus on the shooting; 

2. For the moment we removed "time freeze" temporarily, it'll return in the future with more gorgeous experience. We also changed skill "cool down" into a less distracting "energy bar", You need to collect energy during shooting, then activate different skills when the bar grows to 50% or MAX;

3. Total rebuilt the "shield" skill,  when activated(energy bar reaches 50%), a breakable power shield will be open right in front of you;

4. Both hands can transform now. When activate the "super cannon" skill (energy bar reaches MAX), both hands will transform automatically, holding 2 cannonballs in each;

5. Swing down controllers to reload is now applied.

We can't be sure if this version is a bold move, we'd just like to make the skills more stick to Revoke's core gameplay.  Feedbacks are always welcome!



Thanks,
Ke

notes.title: Demo Urgent Update, Several Optimizations and New Gun Added.
First Update Coming Soon and EULA Removed
notes.notes:
Thank you guys for all the feedbacks! We’ve been discussing them all day and will make an update very soon.  

Adjustments shall be made to most part of the gameplay, such as gun weight , sound effects and shooting feedbacks. One thing for sure is that, we’ll spare no effort to make this game a beyond happy experience for each of you.



Yours,
Ke

notes.title: We are taking the Beta version of Revoke to PAX East!
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

The development of our beta version is coming to an end, we are so excited to see people first play it in PAX! Feedbacks we're going to collect there could be really important to us. 

This version will contain most subjects and gameplay, which is very different (skills, enemies) from what our first trailer showsːsteamhappyː. 

So see you next month! 


Cheers,
Ke from NEUN Games
